newsitem.title: NORWAY: Storms halt oil loadings at Statfjord, Gullfaks.
newsitem.headline: Storms halt oil loadings at Statfjord, Gullfaks.

text.p: Crude loadings at the North Sea Statfjord and Gullfaks oilfields were halted on Monday due to hurricane-force winds and rough seas, operator Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil ) said.
Statoil said production at both fields was normal, but output at the Statfjord C platform would be reduced to a minimum at 0200 GMT on Tuesday due to a lack of storage capacity.

"We had to stop loading yesterday lunch time. There are four tankers waiting to load but the wind is between 75 and 80 knots and the waves are 11 to 18 metres high," the spokeswoman said. "The wind is expected to get even stronger."
The spokeswoman said Statfjord A had storage for another 30 hours of production, while Statfjord B still had two days. Statfjord C was 90 percent full.
Gullfaks A storage was half full and Gullfaks C had enough capacity to pump for a further two days, she said.
